acquisition_environment.network: Only authenticated exact-revision origin for later approved acquisition
acquisition_environment.secrets: Acquisition process only; never inherited/mounted into execution
acquisition_environment.staging: Dedicated root with >=250000000000 free bytes before acquisition
body_procedure: Acquire only16 declared shard paths from exact revision into temporary files
Stream SHA256 + byte-count; reject mismatch; retain receipts, never accept ETag as body proof
Validate safetensors headers/index keys/dtypes without instantiating model
Atomic promote only complete authenticated snapshot; chmod read-only
Hash/authenticate downloaded runtime inputs independently; build runtime before offline execution

execution_environment.image: final content-addressed digest PENDING; mutable tags prohibited
execution_environment.user: dedicated non-root UID/GID PENDING exact image
execution_environment.input_worker_boundary: Supervisor prepares allowlisted input bytes/token IDs; worker sees only frozen model/runtime/input/scopedoutput; no dynamic repository reads
execution_environment.GPU_exposure: One verified device UUID only; TP1
execution_environment.model_output_execution: Never execute as shell, Python, callback or tool request
reset: Fresh process/RNG/adapter/optimizer for lifecycle and K/R reset boundaries
Kernel cache either immutable predeclared hash or new scoped scratch; always record identity
execution_environment.isolation_enforcement: External OS mount/network/capability boundary, not model obedience

separation_rule: Destroy acquisition credentials/session; execution starts from hash-verified snapshot and immutable runtime with no acquisition network
